header.running_head: The Sahabah (RA) Pledge their Allegiance at the Hands of the Khulafaa (RA)

blocks.text: have stated that they went to pledge their allegiance to Rasulullaah ﷺ when they were only seven years of age. When Rasulullaah ﷺ saw the two of them, he smiled, stretched out his hands and accepted their pledges.[^1]
Hadhrat Hirmaas bin Ziyaad (RA) narrates that he was still a child when he stretched out his hands to pledge his allegiance to Rasulullaah ﷺ, but Rasulullaah ﷺ did not accept the pledge from him.[^2]
The Sahabah (RA) Pledge their Allegiance at the Hands of the Khulafaa (RA)
The Sahabah (RA) pledge their Allegiance at the Hand of Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA)

Hadhrat Muntashir narrates from his father that when the Sahabah (RA) pledged their allegiance at the hands of Rasulullaah ﷺ, he stipulated that their pledges be solely for the pleasure of Allaah and that they pledge to always obey the truth. This was after the revelation of the verse:

blocks.arabic_text: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ يُبَايِعُوْنَكَ اِنَّمَا يُبَايِعُوْنَ اللّٰهَ
blocks.text: "Indeed those who pledge their allegiance to you (O Rasulullaah ﷺ) they really pledge their allegiance to Allaah."

When Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) took the pledge of allegiance from people, he said to them, "You are obliged to honour your pledge to me as long as I am obedient to Allaah." Thereafter, the pledge of allegiance that Hadhrat Umar (RA) and those after him took from people was like the pledge that Rasulullaah ﷺ took from people.[^3]

Hadhrat Ibn Afeef (RA) narrates that he saw Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) accepting the pledge of allegiance form people after the demise of Rasulullaah ﷺ. When a group of Sahabah (RA) would gather before him, he would say to them, "Do you pledge at my hands that you would listen and obey Allaah, His Book and then the Ameer?" Only when they agreed to this did Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) accept their pledges of allegiance.

Hadhrat Ibn Afeef (RA) says further, "It was when I came of age or some time afterwards that I used to stand by Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) and memorised the conditions he made with people (when they came to pledge their allegiance). I then approached and started saying, 'I pledge at your hands that I will listen and obey Allaah, His Book and then the Ameer.' He then looked at me from top to bottom. I guessed that I must have impressed him. (He then accepted my pledge of allegiance) May Allaah shower His mercy on him."[^4]

Tabraani. Haythami (Vol.9 Pg.285) has commented on the chain of narrators. Abu Nu'aym and Ibn Asaakir have also reported the Hadith from Hadhrat Urwa (RA), who states that Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Zubayr (RA) and Abdullaah bin Ja'far (RA) both pledged their allegiance to Rasulullaah ﷺ when they were only seven years of age. This is also mentioned in Muntakhab (Vol.5 Pg.227).
